hooks.command: cmd=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("command", ""))'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git push.*--force|git reset[[:space:]]+--hard|git clean[[:space:]]+-f|DROP TABLE)'; then echo 'ERROR: dangerous command detected - please confirm with user before running' && exit 1; fi
hooks.statusMessage: 危険なコマンドをチェック中...

hooks.command: file=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd /Users/shinobu-takahata/app/project-template/backend && uv run ruff format "$file" 2>&1 && uv run ruff check --fix "$file" 2>&1 | head -20; fi
hooks.statusMessage: ruff でフォーマット中...

hooks.command: file=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && echo "$file" | grep -q 'frontend/'; then cd /Users/shinobu-takahata/app/project-template/frontend && npx eslint --fix "$file" 2>&1 | head -20; fi

file=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); if echo "$file" | grep -q 'alembic/versions/'; then if ! grep -q 'def upgrade' "$file" || ! grep -q 'def downgrade' "$file"; then echo 'WARNING: alembic migration missing upgrade() or downgrade()' && exit 1; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: マイグレーション構造をチェック中...

hooks.command: latest=$(ls -dt /Users/shinobu-takahata/app/project-template/.steering/*/tasklist.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$latest" ]; then incomplete=$(grep -c '\[ \]' "$latest" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$incomplete" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Reminder: $latest has $incomplete incomplete tasks - please update tasklist progress."; fi; fi
